newsitem.title: USA: Cold weather should bypass Brazil coffee belt- WSC.
newsitem.headline: Cold weather should bypass Brazil coffee belt- WSC.

text.p: Warm, high pressure dominating Brazil's coffee belt is expected to remain basically unchanged for the next seven days, Weather Services Corp said in an update on Monday.
"Colder weather forecast to build into Argentina on Friday should pass off to the south of the coffee belt over the weekend", WSC said.
Scattered showers and thunderstorms were reported in growing areas over the last two days. Low temperatures ranged from 52-63 F (11-17 C).

Partly to mostly cloudy skies with episodes of scattered showers are expected in the region for the next five days. Temperatures should remain near to above normal. Low temperatures are expected to be in the 50's to low 60's F (low to middle teens C).
Heavy rains in the growing areas of northern Parana may cause delays in the harvest, according to WSC. "Some harvest losses cannot be ruled out if this wet weather pattern continues," WSC said.
